selection_rationale.new_parent: R1 exact trained C; R2 disjoint same-parent C held out from adaptation, not unseen-parent generalization
selection_rationale.old_train: Four actual pool parents, two whole coherent C each: flat seat/back, seat/closed lower box, flat seat/curved U support, curved seat/inner back
selection_rationale.old_dev: Four old-panel parents covering back, seat, closed support and seat-support assembly; part_type metadata overrides misleading old filenames
selection_rationale.limits: Small fixed development panel; source GT is one completion, no unique-parent reconstruction success; no claimed official-pretraining novelty

inference_policy: C/N-only per-model learned head; no Y/source owner/alias correction at deployment
metric_contract: Unchanged original scoring chain; S/E NA without registered requirement; closed C seam fields NA; open predicted all-null graph stays zero, not NA
gallery_policy: Old DEV frames exact inherited; new frames from source before generation; azimuth -60/120 elevation23, central front/side section index1; frozen across models/stages
source_GT_use: Display framing and supervision provenance only, never unique completion success
